decision: revise shared representation; do not promote

findings.evidence: All three initial hero views show thin horizontal pads; C especially looks unsupported at normal scale.
findings.hypothesis: Terminal-only coverage and near-horizontal sprays lack volume and secondary connective growth.
findings.action: Add leaf-bearing outer secondary intervals and more varied upper/side spray orientation.

findings.evidence: Branch-only views show a recognizable spread but fine wire-like distal support.
findings.cause: Verified shared hierarchy used legacy child radius cap .68 and tip ratio .012 for this new broad scaffold.
findings.action: Add opt-in declarative attachment/tip controls; leave existing defaults unchanged.

findings.evidence: Initial hero crown surfaces compress into deep green with little selective warm variation.
findings.action: Retain cool interiors while adjusting the common opt-in material body/rim response.

scope: Failure of these implementations, not proof that umbrella, wind-shaped or tiered architecture concepts are unsuitable.
